newsitem.title: USA: Zentex to merge with Brighton companies.
newsitem.headline: Zentex to merge with Brighton companies.

text.p: Zentex Corp said on Wednesday it planned to merge with two private telecommunications and computer companies - Brighton Industries Corp and Hong Kong-based Brighton Electronics Corp.
Zentex said in a statement the merger represented a tax-deferred reorganization of the company but further details would only be available when the deal was concluded.
Zentex, which signed a letter of intent, said it would be the surviving entity and would change its name to Brighton Technologies. The deal was expected to be completed within 30 days, it said.

The Brighton cos, which are two distinct units with the same owner, have sold over $100 million of computer and communications hardware and software systems throughout China, Zentex said. The Brighton companies would merger before the Zentex merger, a company spokesman said.
Brighton just secured a contract with an operating arm of the Chinese government to build a Securities Trading Automated Quotation System, Zentex said.

After the merger, Brighton would seek secondary funding between $10 million and $13 million to complete the network's deployment, Zentex said. It already invested $2.1 million in building this new nationwide stock exchange, which was running in beta-test mode in three Chinese cities, the company said.
